comparison.objective: Fit a spring tension rod between cupboard walls at a marked height so friction holds it level.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial spring compression, bimanual positioning between planes, height/level adjustment, and controlled release.
comparison.success_condition: Rod remains level at the marked height, supported by both walls after release without slipping or damage.
comparison.reason: This tests spring preload and frictional retention; impact and bimanual stabilization are used for a different mechanism and outcome.
